Name: Sheresh
Summary: Son of Machir by Maachah, and brother of Peresh.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:16: Son of Machir by Maachah, and brother of Peresh.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Sheresh stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
